agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has no pushes and sensor_noise 0; failure is deterministic drift. Initial x=-0.31 with negative velocity -0.48 drives cart left. Controller force remains small (~0.32N at step 100, ~0.59N at step 200, ~0.89N at step 264) far below force_limit 41.44, and pole angle stays well within limit (theta ~-0.08 rad, margin ~0.72 at violation), so controller is pole-stabilizing but not cart-centering enough. Cart position monotonically decreases and velocity magnitude increases: x=-0.86 at step 100, -1.61 at step 200, -2.20 at step 250, -2.34 at step 260, -2.408 at step 264 exceeding track limit. Energy remains bounded, no external pushes, so cause is insufficient cart-position authority/gain in the state-feedback law for this plant (cart_mass 0.85, pole_mass 0.29, pole_length 0.94) to arrest the initial negative momentum before hitting the track end.
